breakout_momentum.rule: a watchlist name up 5% or more on the day: buy 2% of the book, expecting continuation

social.rule: brand attention: the 28-day mean of Wikipedia views >= 3 SD above its 52-week baseline and rising week on week, stock not up >15% in 20 trading days: buy 2% of the book at the next US session
social.rationale: Decision C8 (owner 30 Oct 08:15Z, cmsg_01U4KMvkBYNknqm4HRVie8uvBtdf8FXmpAzFnMCC6ZTscw), spec research/strategies/C8_SOCIAL_AND_MERGER_ARB.md. swing.rationale: Decision C9 (owner 30 Oct 11:35Z, cmsg_01U4KMvkBYNknqm4HRVie8uvRPwS2yiiKExfRMKcoE5PHU), spec research/strategies/C9_SQUEEZE_AND_GAP.md. Forward-only on the C6 watchlist; C6 sizing, sleeve stops and the 30-trade kill rule apply. Missing data means no signal.

squeeze.rule: 20-day Bollinger bandwidth in the lowest 10% of 250 days, then a close above the 20-day high on >=1.5x volume above the 200-day average: buy next session

gap.rule: 3-12% gap up still holding >=20% of the gap 30-60 min after the US open, above the open and the first-30-minute VWAP: buy, stop at the first-30-minute low, +6% target, flat by the close

value_timing.rule: month-end: hold US value (VRVA) when Russell 1000 Value's 12-month total return (IWD) beats Growth's (IWF), else the S&P 500 (VUSA)
value_timing.rationale: Research loop Q48a passed its pre-registered test 30 Oct 2026 (results/Q44_Q48.md): +3.6%/yr vs the US market 1927-2022, t 4.23, both halves positive, survives costs x2 and a 1-month lag; only +1.3%/yr since 2007. The signal uses the Russell 1000 Value/Growth ETFs (IWD/IWF) as the nearest free proxy for the Ken French value/growth portfolios; Vanguard Russell 1000 US Value (VRVA, LSE, USD) tracks the same value index. The stop is a -50% disaster stop only: the tested rule has none. Demo only; kill after 30 closed trades or 730 days if it does not beat VWRP. Follow-up Q49-Q52: the same rule outside the US is weak (t 1.74 developed ex-US, t 1.56 EM, flat since 2007): low confidence.

momentum_timing.approximation: the tested rule (Q50a) compared the KF winners decile with the losers decile; no ETF holds the losers, so the signal is US momentum (MTUM) vs the US market (IWB)
momentum_timing.rule: month-end: hold US momentum (IUMO) when MSCI USA Momentum's 12-month total return (MTUM) beats the Russell 1000's (IWB), else the S&P 500 (VUAG)
momentum_timing.rationale: Research loop Q50a passed its pre-registered test 30 Oct 2026 (results/Q49_Q52.md): +5.4%/yr vs the US market 1928-2022, t 4.71, both halves positive, survives costs x2 and a 1-month lag, +2.2%/yr since 2007. Deliberate approximation: momentum vs market replaces winners vs losers. iShares Edge MSCI USA Momentum Factor (IUMO, LSE, USD) is a looser match than the paper decile. VUAG (Vanguard S&P 500 Acc) is the market leg so this never shares value_timing's VUSA line. -50% disaster stop only. Demo only; kill after 30 closed trades or 730 days if it does not beat VWRP. Follow-up Q55a (results/Q54_Q55.md) tested this exact signal: t 4.68 over 1928-2022 but only +0.2%/yr since 2007 and t 0.64 outside the US: low confidence, a cheap forward test.

january_small.rule: calendar: hold US small caps (Vanguard Russell 2000, VRSG) from the first LSE open of January to the first open of February; no position otherwise
january_small.rationale: Research loop Q65a passed its pre-registered test 31 Oct 2026 (results/Q61_Q65.md): +3.0%/yr vs the US market 1926-2022, t 5.07. LOW confidence: the classic January effect, -0.8%/yr since 2007 after publication. -50% disaster stop only. Demo only; first trade January 2027; kill after 30 closed trades or 730 days if it does not beat VWRP (the 730 days binds first).

stock_screen.rebalance: Weekly check of the 1/12 refresh (research Q214; owner asked 6 Nov why it waits a month): as soon as each research data rebuild finishes (weekly, Mondays 05:41Z, ~2h, log research/stock-screener/REBUILD_LOG.md; owner 6 Nov: do it now, never wait for a set time; trade the same day if the US market is open, else at the next open; skip if prices_monthly was not modified today or monthly_metrics.csv.gz has no rows for the current month), run python3 research/stock_screener/pick1.py live <current YYYY-MM> out.csv on branch claude/project-thread-b35v9o, then python3 -m market_agent screen-refresh out.csv --month <YYYY-MM>. At most ONE scheduled swap per calendar month (tested 1/12 turnover): the first Monday that finds a swap uses it (re-run with --record after the config edit); later Mondays that month return log_only, except an extra swap for a held name gone from the gated list (logged as a stock_screen_alert). It skips when every held name is in the top 15; otherwise it names ONE sale (oldest entry; ties: lowest score this month, or a name gone from the gated list) and the best-scored name not held (max 3 per SIC2), plus a refill for any name sold on a hard SEC event. Check the +-10pt sector look-through, then edit picks (sale out, buy in, with its T212 ticker and CIK), previous_picks and picks_month. The sold name exits with reason rebalance.

stock_screen.watch: Every 15 min (intervals_s.screen_watch): SEC submissions of each held name. SELL on an 8-K with item 1.03, 3.01, 4.01 or 4.02, or a delisting (25/25-NSE/15-12B), merger (DEFM14A/PREM14A) or tender (SC TO-T/SC 14D9) filing; the cash is held until the next monthly refresh. Rules: research Q200/Q201 (interim selling did worse than holding).
